selection_rationale: Official combined personal-EV SOC profile from the repository.
Natural annual boundary continuity after 365-day tiling.
No synthetic final-day boundary correction required.
Moderate annual use of approximately 90.90 EFC.
Reaches q=0.80 in a practical modeled time compared with the less intensive personal-large case.
Avoids the commercial candidate's extreme 657 EFC/year.
transition_definition: The same internally consistent battery object is transitioned to stationary service when model q reaches 0.80.
important_boundaries: q=0.80 is an analytical transition threshold, not a universal EV retirement rule.
Resistance r is a normalized model output, not direct ohmic resistance.
The first-life degradation scalar of 2.75 follows the official EV notebook example and is scenario-specific.
The stationary service profile was generated using fixed 42-kWh dispatch capacity and Miami climate.
This validates state continuity, not pack-level second-life safety.
